company.name: Fintopio
company.shortDescription: Fintopio is a Global fintech and cryptocurrency company.
company.description: Fintopio is a modern Web3 fintech platform that combines CeFi (Centralized Finance) and DeFi (Decentralized Finance) into a seamless digital wallet experience. The platform is designed to simplify cryptocurrency payments, asset management, and blockchain interactions across Telegram, web, iOS, and Android applications.

productsAndServices.description: A digital wallet that integrates centralized finance (CeFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) functionalities, allowing users to switch instantly between custodial and non-custodial modes.

productsAndServices.description: A service to send cryptocurrency using social media usernames through the Fintopio app or Telegram chat.

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables sending cryptocurrency as gifts to anyone, including recipients without a Fintopio wallet.
